test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In what ratio must a shopkeeper mix two types of rice worth ₹60/kg and ₹80/kg, respectively, so that, the average cost of mixture is ₹75/kg?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of first type of rice = ₹60/kg

Cost of second type of rice = ₹80/kg

Average cost of the mixture = ₹75/kg

**Formula used:**

The formula for the average cost of the mixture when mixing two items is:

Average cost = (Cost of first type × Quantity of first type + Cost of second type × Quantity of second type)
